title: Write a greeting
summary: Fortran: Write a greeting. Change the name.
introduction: A program block holds the steps. The A format writes character text.

blocks.text: Install GNU Fortran. Save each example as lesson.f90, run gfortran -std=f2008 lesson.f90 -o lesson, then run it.

blocks.title: Write a greeting
blocks.code:
program lesson
  implicit none

write(*,'(A)') "Hello, Asha!"
end program lesson

blocks.text: The A format writes character data. The string is sent to the default output unit.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: implicit none makes you declare variable types instead of guessing them.

seo.title: Fortran: Write a greeting
